Both gates (over 0.8 km and over 20%) pass, so a deviation is established, and the trace is unimpaired — 214 fixes, 10-second spacing, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s — so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) do not escalate it. The driver's closure explanation succeeds under POL-RD-03. The LTA advisory ADV-20260907-070 (EV-ADVIS-02809-01) closes the CTE towards the AYE after Braddell Road, on a corridor the optimal route traverses (intersects_route true) — limb (a); its window 20:44:02–22:14:32 overlaps the trip 21:14:02–21:49:32 by 65.5 minutes, far beyond the 15-minute buffers — limb (b); and the actual route did not traverse the affected segment — the trace records 0 fixes inside the advisory area and a closest approach of 1,344.79 m — so it left the optimal corridor before the segment and rejoined it after — limb (c). The optimal route's own polyline is not in the bundle, so the advisory-area computation is the closest test of limb (c) that the record allows; I have weighed it against the limb and it supports it, rather than the closure being assumed from the fare block. The rider's objection that the vehicle was 'nowhere near' the closure is not a defect in the driver's case: a route that avoids a closed segment is expected to stay outside it, and the recorded facts — optimal route traverses the closure, actual trace does not — are what limb (c) asks for. The exoneration is capped, and the cap absorbs the whole excess: cap = 1.30 x (25.6 - 22.0) + 1.00 = 5.68 km; justified excess = min(5.28, 5.68) = 5.28 km. The closure-adjusted optimal is 22.0 + 5.28 = 27.28 km, duration 37.2 min, leaving no excess to refund. Running POL-RD-02 on the adjusted route: (3.80 + 0.75 x 27.28 + 0.28 x 37.2) x 1.0 surge (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, EV-FARE-02809) + 0.80 platform fee = 35.476, which exceeds the 35.02 charged, so the refund floors at zero and is below the 0.50 de minimis. The charged state (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) therefore stands. Had the closure not excused the excess, POL-RD-02 on the booked optimal would have recomputed the fare at 29.50 and produced 5.52, rounded up to 5.55 — the rider's figure — but that computation does not apply. Limb (c) is not. It requires the actual route to leave the optimal corridor before the affected segment and rejoin it after, and this record cannot show that. The optimal route's own polyline is not in the bundle, and the record itself states that the closest available test — whether the trace enters the advisory's area — decides nothing by itself. The trace never comes within 1,344.79 m of the closed segment and records zero fixes inside it; that is consistent with a detour around the closure, but it is equally consistent with a route that never used that corridor, and it does not show where the booked corridor was left or rejoined. The driver's route is also 1.68 km longer than the shortest lawful alternative the advisory names (25.6 km), and the advisory describes a two-lane closure with a diversion rather than a closed road. REFUND — POL-RD-02. The fare model is METERED and no quoted fare exists, so POL-RD-11 does not apply. Charged total: 35.02. Recomputed fare: (3.80 + 0.75 × 22.0 + 0.28 × 30.0) × 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 3.80 + 16.50 + 8.40 + 0.80 = 29.50. Refund: 35.02 − 29.50 = 5.52, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 5.55. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and only 15.76% of the charge, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND, not a full one. The rider's filed figure of SGD 4.50 understates the arithmetic the clause fixes. NOTHING ADDED OR NETTED. The chat log is empty and no pickup or dropoff was amended, so POL-RD-04 and POL-RD-05 give nothing, and no driver compensation is due (the distance billed, 27.3 km, is not less than the trace records). REPEAT-DEVIATION CHECK. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against 202 completed trips in 90 days — neither the 3-flag test nor the 0.05 ratio — so no POL-RD-06 pattern is established; the deviation is also not MATERIAL (24.0% is under 50%, 5.28 km is under 8.0 km). THE REFUND IS ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02, booked optimal route). The fare is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply. Charged total: 35.02. Recomputed fare: (3.80 + 0.75 × 22.0 + 0.28 × 30.0) × 1.0, the surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus 0.80 platform fee = 29.50. Refund 35.02 − 29.50 = 5.52, rounded up to SGD 5.55.
